fixture.label: Demonstration fixture: Aamod is a fictional brand created for the Omnicult demo. Any resemblance to a real company is unintended.

name: Aamod
name_meaning: From Sanskrit आमोद (aamod): delight, joy; also fragrance.
category: Festive sweets and snacks for gifting
description: A packaged festive sweets brand. Its signature product, the Aamod Festive Tin, holds a region-specific assortment of traditional festive sweets and savouries, packed for gifting and delivered before the festival day.

name_check.method: Web searches for the name together with sweets, mithai, foods and gifting in India, and for the bare name as a brand.
name_check.result: No existing well-known brand named Aamod was found in food, sweets or gifting. The nearest hit was AMMOD, an unrelated US trademark.

rejected_candidates.name: Mithora
rejected_candidates.reason: A small sweets business with this name has a website. Also, in Marathi मीठ (meeth) means salt.

rejected_candidates.name: Madhuvi
rejected_candidates.reason: Too close to an existing 'Madhvi Sweets'; and in Tamil மது (madhu) commonly means liquor.

logo.description: A lit diya in a peacock-teal disc: marigold flame, cream lamp bowl, three rangoli dots and a brass ring. Wordmark 'Aamod' in DM Serif Display, converted to outlines.

lockups.use: Horizontal, teal wordmark, on light backgrounds.
Horizontal, cream wordmark, on teal or dark photography.
Avatar, favicon and sizes where the wordmark would be illegible.

logo.clear_space: At least a quarter of the mark's diameter on every side.
rules: Never recolour, stretch, rotate, outline or add effects to the logo.
Keep the Latin wordmark in every region; never translate or transliterate the wordmark inside the logo.
Use the reversed lockup on teal or dark backgrounds.

colours.name: Peacock Teal
colours.role: Primary: pack body, end-card background, wordmark.

colours.name: Marigold
colours.role: Accent: flame, highlights, tagline on dark backgrounds.

colours.name: Ghee Cream
colours.role: Light background, text on dark backgrounds, pack medallion.

colours.name: Brass
colours.role: Rings, rules, pack lid and band. Decorative only, not for text.

pairs.note: Below 4.5:1, so brass is never used for text.

fonts.role: Wordmark, English headlines, product name and tagline.
Marathi and Hindi body, captions, CTA and small print.
English body, CTA and small print next to Indic text.

typography_rules: Indic text is always rendered in code with these fonts (HarfBuzz shaping), never drawn by an image model.
One headline face per script: Noto Serif <script> Bold; English headlines in DM Serif Display.
Captions at least 40 px tall on a 1080 x 1920 frame.

tone_of_voice.summary: Warm, familial and gently playful. Celebrates shared festive rituals through specific, sensory detail.
do: Speak like a member of the family, not a salesperson.
Use each region's own words for its festivals, foods and relationships.
Show real moments of giving: siblings, grandparents, neighbours.
Keep calls to action practical: delivery dates and how to order.
dont: No health, nutrition or financial claims.
No superiority or No. 1 claims unless independently substantiated, with the source and date shown.
No stereotypes or caricature of any community; never mock a custom.
Never borrow one region's festival words for another region.

tagline.note: Shown and voiced in English in every region.

protected_terms.rule: Never translate. Transliterate only as listed in the Brand Glossary.
Never translate. Transliterate only as listed in the Brand Glossary.

never_change.description: Logo artwork, colours and proportions, in every lockup.

The Aamod Festive Tin exterior: cylindrical peacock-teal tin, brass-gold lid and base rim, gold paisley band, cream medallion with the stacked logo. The assortment inside may change by region; the tin may not.
never_change.bbox_note: Normalised [x, y, w, h] within brand/pack.png.

never_change.description: The English tagline on end cards and key visuals.

product_images.description: Branded packshot of the Aamod Festive Tin.
product_images.provenance: Tin generated by gemini-3.1-flash-image (no text requested); cut out, medallion cleaned and stacked logo composited in code.

product_images.description: The same tin with the emblem only and no lettering. Given to the image model as a reference so every generated scene shows the same pack.
product_images.provenance: Derived from the generated tin in code.

allowed: True product facts of the fictional product: contents, net weight (750 g), delivery window.
forbidden: Superiority, leadership or No. 1 claims without independent substantiation.
